description: Parametric switch storage box for Kailh Choc v1 (PG1350) and Choc v2 (PG1353)
notes: All parameters carry mm or deg units. Unitless Fusion parameters do not appear in the MakerWorld customizer.
cols and rows are counts expressed in mm; the model divides by 1 mm internally so the units cancel.
label_w, label_h and label_depth are clamped inside the model. Values beyond the usable area are reduced automatically rather than failing to generate.
label_depth is clamped to a 0.2-0.6mm band that always leaves 1.2mm of wall. Reserving the full 1.75mm structural minimum yields a zero-depth cut at minimum wall, which fails.

parameters.name: rib_depth
parameters.label: Snap tightness
parameters.description: Rib protrusion per side. Lower is looser.

parameters.name: label_w
parameters.label: Label width
parameters.description: Front label recess width, clamped to the flat run between fillets

parameters.name: label_h
parameters.label: Label height
parameters.description: Front label recess height, clamped to fit above the stack ring

parameters.name: label_depth
parameters.label: Label depth
parameters.description: Recess depth, clamped to 0.2-0.6mm and to leave 1.2mm of wall

parameters.name: stack_angle
parameters.label: Stack draft
parameters.description: Draft angle of the stacking ring
